Theorema I. Productum infinitum
$F(\varphi,x) = (1+2\cos 2\varphi\, xx + x^4)(1+2\cos 2\varphi\, x^6+x^{12})(1+2\cos 2\varphi\, x^{10}+x^{20})$ etc.
evolvitur in seriem
$Gx [-X-] (1+2xx\cos 2\varphi + 2x^8\cos 4\varphi + 2x^{18}\cos 6\varphi + $ etc.$)$
ita vt sit $\overset{Gx}{[-X-]}$ functio ipsius $x$
Denotando productum infinitum $(1-t)(1-tt)(1-t^3)(1-t^4)$...
per $\Pi t$ erit
$F(\frac{1}{2}R,x) = [-\frac{\Pi x^{16}\Pi x^4}{\Pi xx}-] = G[-X-]x\,(1-2x^8+2x^{32}\ldots) = \frac{(\Pi x^8)^2}{\Pi x^4\,\Pi x^{16}}$
$F(R,x) = \left(\frac{\Pi xx}{\Pi x^4}\right)^2 = G[-X-]x\,(1-2xx+2x^8-2x^{18}$
$F(0,x) = \left(\frac{\Pi x^8}{\Pi xx}\right)^2 = G[-X-]x\,(1+2xx+2x^8+2x^{18} = \frac{\Pi 4^4}{\Pi 2^2\,\Pi 8^2}$
Ponendo $1-2xx+2x^8\ldots = \mathfrak{A}x$ erit
$\frac{\mathfrak{A}x^4}{\mathfrak{A}x^{[?]}} = [-\frac{\Pi x^{16}}{\Pi xx}-]\frac{\Pi x^4}{\Pi xx}\,\frac{\Pi x^8\,\Pi x^8}{\Pi xx\,\Pi x^{16}}$ Hinc sequitur
1) $\mathfrak{A}x = \frac{\Pi xx\,\Pi xx}{\Pi x^4 [-\ldots-]}$ ; 2) $Gx = \frac{1}{\Pi x^4} = \frac{1}{(1-x^4)(1-x^8)(1-x^{12})\ldots}$
$\frac{(\Pi x)^8(\Pi -x)^{16} - (\Pi x)^{16}(\Pi -x)^8}{16x} = (\Pi xx)^{24}$
$\frac{\Pi -xx}{\Pi +xx} = \sqrt[4]{\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{(\Pi -x)^2}{(\Pi +x)^2}+\frac{(\Pi +x)^2}{(\Pi -x)^2}\right)}$
$\left((\Pi -x)^8 - (\Pi +x)^8\right) : 16x = (\Pi x^4)^8$
